posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid reports of a professional rift; fans continue to speculate about her life in London with Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Continues to ride high after selling out Madison Square Garden and his historic US tour; recently discussed a potential Shakira collaboration for an Indian version of 'Hips Don't Lie.'

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Turned heads at Cannes 2026, addressing gender representation in Indian cinema; gearing up for her YRF spy film 'Alpha' alongside Sharvari.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Returns to Indian cinema in SS Rajamouli's epic 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, set for April 2027; continues sharing heartfelt family moments with daughter Malti and Nick Jonas.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Filming 'King' (2026) while reuniting with Anil Kapoor, Rani Mukerji, and Jackie Shroff; buzz grows around a possible 'Main Hoon Na' sequel with Farah Khan.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Set to reunite with Salman Khan in a Raj & DK superhero film for 2027; wished Karan Johar on his birthday as 'Chand Mera Dil' hits theatres.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Currently shooting fantasy film 'Naagin' directed by Laxman Utekar; in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in mythological drama 'Mahavatar.'

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' due to motherhood priorities; spoke out powerfully against overwork culture, emphasizing support for new mothers.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Faces FWICE non-cooperation directive over his exit from 'Don 3,' with ₹45 crore in damages demanded; made his first masked public appearance at Mumbai Airport.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Dazzled at Cannes 2026 with stunning couture looks including a feathered cape and swan-inspired ensemble; daughter Aaradhya beamed with pride as fans lined up for autographs.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Presented at the Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Winston Duke who called her 'incomparable'; her romantic track 'Tujhko' from 'Cocktail 2' with Shahid Kapoor is out now.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Makes her acting comeback in 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' — the fierce trailer showcases her intense role as a warrior daughter-in-law, releasing June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: His mega collaboration with director Atlee, 'AA22xA6,' is officially announced as a VFX-heavy sci-fi spectacle co-starring Deepika Padukone, set for 2027.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: His ₹350 crore sports drama 'Peddi' is generating massive buzz — North American advance booking crossed $393K ahead of the June 4 release; hilariously apologized to Jasprit Bumrah after calling him a footballer.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Celebrated his birthday on May 20 with major reveals — the 'Dragon' glimpse hit 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours, plus Devara 2 poster and 'God of War' announcement.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Promoting 'Peddi' alongside Ram Charan with high-energy appearances; her film 'Homebound' was selected as India's official entry for the 2026 Oscars.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Her film 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya earned ₹18 crore worldwide in its opening weekend; faced backlash over a Bharatanatyam dance sequence that sparked cultural debate.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Set to portray legendary actress Madhubala in a Sanjay Leela Bhansali biopic; shut down rumors about requesting cuts in her upcoming film 'Toxic' with Yash.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: 'War 2' with Jr NTR is India's most expensive spy thriller at ₹400 crore, featuring a ₹50 crore profit share for Hrithik; set to make his directorial debut with 'Krrish 4.'

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: His romantic comedy 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with Pooja Hegde is set for June release; the recreated 'Chunnari Chunnari' track drew mixed reactions from fans and original singer Abhijeet.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Wrapped her 'All Hearts Tour' with a homecoming Mumbai finale at Jio Garden; announces upcoming US concert dates including Texas Trust CU Theatre in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: Praised Hans Zimmer's collaboration on 'Ramayana,' calling it one of India's greatest films; composed the music for Ram Charan's highly anticipated 'Peddi.'

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Celebrated his 51st birthday with wishes pouring in from across the industry; his final film 'Jana Nayagan' faces piracy issues but is expected to release soon.
